effect_description_eng:
[When Digivolving] Trash 2 cards in your hand. Then, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with as much or less DP as this Digimon.
[End of Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] You may play 1 card with the [Evil], [Dark Dragon] or [Evil Dragon] trait and a play cost of 8 or less from your trash without paying the cost. For each card in your hand, reduce 1 from this effect's play cost maximum.
xros_req: [Digivolve] Lv.5 w/[Dark Dragon]/[Evil Dragon] trait: Cost 4
